name: Haystack
description:
Haystack connects Claude to your company’s Haystack workspace so you can search for people, teams, posts, events, knowledge pages, glossary terms, files, and links you’re already allowed to see. Results open directly in Haystack. The integration is optional, uses secure OAuth, and respects your existing access controls — it does not expand permissions or use your content to train models.

Depending on your current Haystack plan, the Claude connector may require a license add-on. To enable it for your organization or check your eligibility, please reach out to your Haystack Customer Success Manager or contact support@haystackteam.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Haystack to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Haystack to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://haystack-mcp.haystack.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Haystack MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Haystack provides these MCP tools: haystack_ai_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Haystack?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Haystack in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Haystack requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Haystack is developed by Haystack Team Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
